import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

def comps(g,bg):
    from collections import deque
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not seen[i][j] and g[i][j]!=bg:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and g[nx][ny]==c:
                            seen[nx][ny]=True; q.append((nx,ny))
                rs=[c for _,c,_ in []]
                xs=[p[0] for p in cells]; ys=[p[1] for p in cells]
                res.append({'color':c,'size':len(cells),'bbox':(min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys)),'h':max(xs)-min(xs)+1,'w':max(ys)-min(ys)+1})
    return res

# Analyze structure per demo: markers (color with exactly 4 cells), frame = bbox of markers; output = crop.
from collections import Counter
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    cntI=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    mark=[c for c,v in cntI.items() if v==4][0]
    pos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==mark]
    print(k,'marker',mark,'corners',pos, 'frame',(max(p[0] for p in pos)-min(p[0] for p in pos)+1,max(p[1] for p in pos)-min(p[1] for p in pos)+1),'out dims',len(O),len(O[0]))
    # components of non-bg non-marker colors in INPUT, and in OUTPUT
    def comps(g,c,bg):
        H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    col=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cs=[]
                    while q:
                        a,b=q.popleft(); cs.append((a,b))
                        for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen:
                                seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
                    ys=[p[0] for p in cs]; xs=[p[1] for p in cs]
                    out.append((col,min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs),len(cs)))

def solve(I):

    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cands=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if v==4 and c!=bg]
    def frame_info(c):
        pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        return pts,(min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts))
    # marker color: its 4 cells span the full grid height or width / extreme frame
    info={}
    for c in cands:
        pts,bbox=frame_info(c)
        if bbox[0]==0 and bbox[2]==W-1 and bbox[1]!=W-1 or bbox[0]==H-1 and bbox[1]==0 and bbox[2]!=H-1:

    oh,ow=mM-mr+1,mC-mc0+1
    om=[[I[i-mr][j-mc0] for j in range(mC-mc0+1)] for i in range(mM-mr+1)]
    return [[best if (i in (0,oh-1) and j in (0,ow-1)) else om[i][j] for j in range(ow)] for i in range(oh)],best

def find_marker(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c,v in cnt.items():

        pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs={p[0] for p in pts}; cl={p[1] for p in pts}

            mr=min(rs); mM=max(rs); cc0=min(cl); cc1=max(cl)
            area=(mM-mr+1)*(cc1-cc0+1)

def analyze_pair(n):

    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    # marker: color with exactly 4 cells that are isolated singles (corner frame)

            mk=col;break
    assert mk
    p=pos(mk,gi)
    r0=min(x[0] for x in p); r1=max(x[0] for x in p); c0=min(x[1] for x in p); c1=max(x[1] for x in p)
    oh,ow=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1

    # non-marker comps

    strays=[(col,[p[0][0],p[0][1]]) for col in cnt if col!=mk for p in comps(gi,col) if len(p)==1]

    for col,c in comps(go,col) if False else []: pass
    gocnt=Counter(x for r in go for x in r)

steps.input:
# Rule attempt: crop to bounding box of markers (the color that appears 4x at corners / bbox spanning whole grid).
# Check pair 5: markers 8 rows1-20 cols1-8 -> crop rows1..20, cols1..8 = 20x8 ✓. Out == crop?
for i in range(1,9):
    a=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt={}
    for r in a:
        for v,r2 in zip(r,[x for x in r]): pass
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in a for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(j,k,v) for j,r in enumerate(a) for k,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg]
    from collections import defaultdict
    byc=defaultdict(list)
    for j,k,v in pts: byc[v].append((j,k))
    marks=max(byc,key=lambda v:len(byc[v]))
    rs=[p[0] for p in byc[marks]]; cs=[p[1] for p in byc[marks]]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    crop=a[r0:r1+1][c0:c1+1]
    print(i,'marker',marks,'crop',len(crop),'x',len(crop[0]),'out',len(o),'x',len(o[0]),crop==o[:1])
